name: Saudi Arabia: TASI
why: The fund's biggest active bet is the Saudi underweight (about -9 pts, limit -10). A close above the 50-day starts closing it; a break below 9,800 widens it.

name: UAE: Abu Dhabi (FADGI)
tech: Rebounding · above 50d, below 200d · RSI 84 (overbought) · support 9,393 · resistance 9,920
why: Home of IHC, our largest single underweight, plus the ADNOC overweights (Drilling, L&S, Distribution).

name: UAE: Dubai (DFMGI)
why: Emaar, DIB, du, TECOM, DEWA and Talabat. Leading the GCC on property, banks and the DIB-Emirates Islamic deal.

name: Qatar: QE Index
tech: Rebounding · above 50d, below 200d · RSI 50 · support 9,575 · resistance 10,177
why: Qatar overweight (about +2.6 pts) through Islamic banks, telecoms and Woqod; Qatar is the US-Iran mediator.

name: Kuwait: Premier Market
why: Kuwait overweight (about +1.7 pts) through KFH and Zain: low-beta, non-oil earnings.

name: Kuwait: All Share
why: Broad Kuwait market, for context on the Premier index.

name: US: S&P 500
why: Global risk appetite. Sharp US sell-offs have pulled foreign money out of the GCC on the same days.

name: US: Nasdaq Composite
why: The AI-led sell-off; tells us how much global de-risking is hitting emerging markets.

name: US volatility (VIX)
why: Stress gauge. Above about 25, risk-on GCC rallies tend to fade and low beta pays.

name: Brent crude ($/bbl)
why: Our oil rules: below $90 (settle) cuts ADNOC Drilling and takes Luberef to index weight; above $100 rebuilds an Aramco overweight.

name: WTI crude ($/bbl)
why: US benchmark; inventory builds have led the oil decline.

name: Gold ($/oz)
why: Drives Ma'aden (we are underweight); gold's slide hit Ma'aden on 22-Nov.

name: Copper ($/lb)
why: Input cost passed through by Riyadh Cables and Electrical Industries; watch their gross margins.

name: US 10-year yield (%)
tech: Pullback in uptrend · below 50d, above 200d · RSI 48 · support 4.84% · resistance 5.14%
why: Discount rate for GCC assets: the Saudi riyal, dirham and Qatari riyal pegs import US rates. Higher yields weigh on property (Emaar, Aldar, Barwa).

name: US 2-year yield (%)
tech: Pullback in uptrend · below 50d, above 200d · RSI 54 · support 4.47% · resistance 4.88%
why: Tracks what the market expects the Fed to do next; a December hike is close to fully priced.

name: US dollar index (DXY)
why: GCC currencies are pegged to the dollar (Kuwait to a basket), so a strong dollar tightens local liquidity.
